title: 第三章 大魔头震惊一脸第四章 取她鲜血必遭雷劈
slug: 被弃龙崽崽三界仙兽都是我喂哒
lines: “汪汪！”
大胖欢快的围着比玄稷还要高点的超大狗尾巴草转悠。
小主人也太厉害了！
“大胖你比比，狗尾巴草比你的尾巴还大呢！”
玄稷还没高兴完，脸色一白，虚弱的啪叽栽倒。
小小的人此刻觉得天旋地转的，肚子更是饿的咕咕叫。
正把自己尾巴高高翘起，跟狗尾巴草对比的大胖见状，忙用狗嘴咬下一穗狗尾巴送到小主人面前。
见小主人还难受的起不来，一定是饿坏了。
干脆扯下一嘴的狗尾巴草果仁递到小主人嘴边。
“汪汪！”
小主人快吃！
大胖心疼的舔舐小主人的脸和裂开的唇。
闻到一丝血腥味，小主人受伤了！
连带那丝血迹也舔了。
刚舔两下，大胖忽然浑身抽搐重重栽倒在地。
狗眼里满是惊恐，时而痛的瞳孔涣散，痛的喉咙发出微弱的呜咽声。
怎么那么疼？
浑身就像被撕裂，像在岩浆中炙烤，又像掉入千年寒冰。
大胖此时浑身痉挛抽抽的频率都变的微弱了。
胖要死了吗？
它狗嘴大张想对小主人道别，却吐出了鲜血，鼻耳也都往外渗血。
大胖是背对着玄稷倒下的，玄稷只以为大胖和自己好，陪着自己一起倒地上休息呢。
她实在是饿，张嘴咬住一颗种子，牙齿一咬就破壳。
里面是鲜嫩带点果实口感的清甜绿米仁。
一颗下肚一股温润生机流窜全身，玄稷不懂那是什么，就觉得浑身舒坦有劲了。
嘴唇上的裂伤正以肉眼可见的速度长好了。
“胖也次，太好次啦~”
玄稷边吃，边不忘也给大胖喂几粒果仁。
然而下一秒——
“啊！大胖你怎么了？哇——大胖你不要死呜呜……”
玄稷转过来才发现大胖的惨样，吓得不行也顾不上吃了，抱着狗头哇哇就是哭。
“大胖我不要你死呜呜……”
大胖想再最后看看小主人，可是根本看不清，眼眶一热想哭，却流出来更多的鲜红。
玄稷见大胖泣血，哭的更大声了。
“大胖你这样我好害怕呜呜……”
刚被养父献祭抛弃，现在又面临相依为命的大胖要死了，小小的人恐慌到极点。
她害怕的抱着狗头哭的眼泪一串串，鼻涕大把，全蹭大胖狗头上，更多的眼泪鼻涕直接流进大胖因剧痛大张的狗嘴里。
要是平时大胖早就帮她舔干净鼻涕眼泪了，现在正遭受濒死疼痛的大胖，确是有心无力。
躺在地上一直不能动的范沐禾见状，心急火燎的，特别想到跟前亲自查看什么情况。
content_en:
"Woof woof!"
The big fat man happily wandered around the super-large dogtail grass that was even taller than Xuanji.
The little master is so awesome!
"Big Fatty, you are so cute! The dog's tail grass is bigger than your tail!"
Before Xuan Ji was happy, his face turned pale and he fell down weakly.
The little man felt dizzy at the moment, and his stomach growled with hunger.
Big Fatty, who was raising his tail high to compare with the dog's tail grass, saw this and hurriedly bit off a piece of dog tail with his dog's mouth and sent it to the little master.
Seeing that the little master is still uncomfortable and unable to get up, he must be hungry.
He simply tore off a mouthful of dogtail grass nuts and handed them to the little master's mouth.
"Woof woof!"
Little master, eat quickly!
The fat man licked the little master's face and split lips distressedly.
I smelled a trace of blood, and the little master was injured!
Even the trace of blood was licked.
Just after two licks, the big fat man suddenly twitched and fell heavily to the ground.
The dog's eyes were full of fear, its pupils dilated from time to time due to pain, and it let out a weak whimper from its painful throat.
Why does it hurt so much?
My whole body felt like it was being torn apart, like it was being baked in magma, or like it had fallen into thousand-year-old ice.
At this time, the frequency of spasms and twitching all over the fat man's body became weaker.
Is fat going to kill you?
The dog opened its mouth wide and wanted to say goodbye to its little master, but it spit out blood, and blood oozed from its nose and ears.
Big Fat fell down with his back to Xuan Ji. Xuan Ji only thought that Big Fat was friendly with him and fell to the ground with him to rest.
She was really hungry, so she opened her mouth to bite a seed, and the shell broke open with her teeth.
Inside is a tender, sweet green rice kernel with a fruity texture.
A warm vitality flowed through his whole body. He didn't know what it was, but he felt comfortable and energetic all over.
The laceration on the lip is growing at a speed visible to the naked eye.
"It's good to be fat, so good~"
While Xuan Ji was eating, he didn't forget to feed Big Fat a few nuts.
But the next second——
"Ah! What's wrong with you, big fat guy? Wow - big fat guy, please don't die..."
Xuan Ji turned around and saw the miserable appearance of the fat man. He was so frightened that he didn't even bother to eat. He just cried while holding the dog's head.
"Big Fatty, I don't want you to die..."
The big fat man wanted to take one last look at his little master, but he couldn't see clearly at all. His eyes were hot and he wanted to cry, but more bright red came out.
Xuanji cried louder when he saw Big Fatty crying blood.
"Big Fatty, I'm so scared when you're like this..."
Having just been sacrificed and abandoned by his adoptive father, and now faced with the death of the fat man he depends on, the little man is extremely panicked.
她害怕的抱着狗头哭的眼泪一串串，鼻涕大把，全蹭大胖狗头上，更多的眼泪鼻涕直接流进大胖因剧痛大张的狗嘴里。
Normally, Big Fatty would have licked her nose and tears away, but now that Big Fatty was suffering from the pain of dying, he was really helpless.
Fan Muhe, who had been lying on the ground unable to move, became very anxious when he saw this, especially wanting to check the situation in person.
